document_title: Brownsville let the land go, and Starbase hears SpaceX's tax abatement December 9th
_note: Slide strings read off the render report's text nodes and each frame's own source line by build_copy.py.
caption:
The line moved on a Saturday.

Brownsville commissioners met for six hours and voted unanimously to de-annex land near the port at SpaceX's request. The offer was good that day only. SpaceX agreed to give the city up to $220 million for water and wastewater, the Texas Tribune reported.

Starbase later annexed it. Brownsville's 90-day data center moratorium took effect last week and doesn't reach it, the Tribune reports.

Starbase's City Commission will consider a tax abatement for a SpaceX gas-fired power plant and super-compute facility on about 444 acres. The notice estimates the initial phases at about $24 billion. The Tribune reports the plant could keep the facility off the state's power grid. The public is invited to be heard at 48491 State Highway 4.

Will the commission approve the abatement on December 9th, 28 days from now?

#CameronCounty #Brownsville #Starbase

S1.headline: Brownsville let the land go.
S1.body: Brownsville took the land out of its city limits at SpaceX's request, and Starbase annexed it. Starbase will now consider a tax break for a gas-fired power plant and super-compute facility on the site, which its notice puts at about 444 acres.
strings: Brownsville took the land out of its city limits at SpaceX's request, and Starbase annexed it. Starbase will now consider a tax break for a gas-fired power plant and super-compute facility on the site, which its notice puts at about 444 acres.

S2.headline: About 444 acres, east of Brownsville
S2.body: Between Boca Chica Blvd and the Port of Brownsville, now inside Starbase's limits, in Cameron County. The square holds the tract's area at true scale. The notice gives its area, not its shape.
strings: Between Boca Chica Blvd and the Port of Brownsville, now inside Starbase's limits, in Cameron County. The square holds the tract's area at true scale. The notice gives its area, not its shape.

S3.headline: About $24 billion, and up to $220 million
S3.body: The notice estimates approximately $24 billion for the first phases. SpaceX agreed to give Brownsville up to $220 million for water and wastewater. The estimate is about 109 times that ceiling. One is an estimate and one a payment, so this is scale and not a price.

S4.headline: "Why are we rushing this?"
S4.body: A Brownsville resident asked it at the Saturday meeting, the Tribune reported on August 31st. SpaceX's Sheila McCorkle told commissioners the offer would be off the table unless approved that day. They voted unanimously to de-annex.
strings: A Brownsville resident asked it at the Saturday meeting, the Tribune reported on August 31st. SpaceX's Sheila McCorkle told commissioners the offer would be off the table unless approved that day. They voted unanimously to de-annex.

S5.headline: Brownsville's pause stops at the line
S5.body: Brownsville's 90-day moratorium on data center applications took effect the week before the Tribune's November 10th story. The Tribune says the project in Starbase circumvents it.
labels: one stake per day of the pause

S6.headline: It could make its own power
S6.body: The Tribune reports the gas-fired plant could power the facility without connecting to the state grid. It says the Governor had grid operators pause data center connection requests in August, pending audits. Drawn to illustrate.

S7.headline: 28 days to be heard
S7.body: Starbase's City Commission meets Wednesday, December 9th. It will consider a Chapter 312 tax abatement and a Chapter 380 agreement with SpaceX.
labels: one chair per day until the hearing
strings: Starbase's City Commission meets Wednesday, December 9th. It will consider a Chapter 312 tax abatement and a Chapter 380 agreement with SpaceX.

S8.headline: Brownsville stands by its vote
S8.body: The city said it decided on the information and circumstances presented at the time. The South Texas Environmental Justice Network has announced a protest over air, water and energy bills. A Brownsville teacher told the Tribune many people need jobs and SpaceX has contributed to them.

S9.headline: Starbase hears the tax break December 9th
S9.body: 7 p.m., 48491 State Highway 4. The notice invites interested persons to attend and be heard on the proposed agreements.
